projectMove.title: A+ Academy: Decide on the Resume Lesson update (PR #13)
projectMove.body: The change that lets the start page resume your latest lesson has been waiting for review since October 1, while the newer lab and Node fixes were merged on October 5. A quick look and a yes or no today would either put the continue button in front of students or let the team close it out, instead of leaving it to drift behind newer work.

tip.title: Practice the Spanish you will actually use on the ship
tip.body: With the cruise twenty days out, spend part of tonight's Spanish session on travel phrases you will really say aboard and ashore, like ordering food, asking for directions, and handling a price. Say each one out loud a few times so it comes out naturally when you need it.
